scope: GH-464 slice 1: main-process on/once/removeListener baseline for the macOS draw.io first-proof IPC path at Electron 44.4.5. Pending implementation only; no renderer transport, native WebKit, product compatibility or whole-family completion claim.

doc_citation.quote:
Listens to `channel`, when a new message arrives `listener` would be called with
`listener(event, args...)`.

cells.test_name: ipc-main.on today: ipcMain.on is absent and a listener cannot be registered
cells.negative_control: Today: exporting an ipcMain object with a callable on method makes this mapped current-behaviour case fail. Exposing only that method leaves the other absent-method baselines unchanged. After GH-466 flips the baseline, removing listener dispatch must produce zero callbacks instead of the expected event and arguments.

doc_citation.quote:
Adds a one time `listener` function for the event. This `listener` is invoked
only the next time a message is sent to `channel`, after which it is removed.

cells.test_name: ipc-main.once today: ipcMain.once is absent and a one-time listener cannot be registered
cells.negative_control: Today: exporting an ipcMain object with a callable once method makes this mapped current-behaviour case fail. Exposing only that method leaves the other absent-method baselines unchanged. After GH-466 flips the baseline, replacing once with on must make two admitted messages invoke the callback twice instead of once; a reentrant send must not call the removed listener again.

cells.test_name: ipc-main.remove-listener today: ipcMain.removeListener is absent and a listener cannot be removed
cells.negative_control: Today: exporting an ipcMain object with a callable removeListener method makes this mapped current-behaviour case fail. Exposing only that method leaves the other absent-method baselines unchanged. After GH-466 flips the baseline, omitting removal must invoke the removed listener once; the unchanged-listener positive control must still fire once.
